z3_ubuntu_apt.version: Ubuntu apt on GitHub Actions, print exact; expected Z3 4.8.12

specialist_baselines.controls: On entirely synthetic HORN safe and unsafe cases, each native engine MUST produce SAT and UNSAT respectively before original scoring. Wrong solver result/syntax is infrastructure failure and doesn't count as hard benchmark.
specialist_baselines.protocol: Run both on byte-identical published original source with exact SHA and 0 changes. Preserve time, verdict/timeout, per-solver stderr and native original stdout. Do not modify first generator proof. Record all 3 originals, including native successes.

cost_definition.per_instance_new_method: frozen original structural Python generator and independent Z3 per-clause UNSAT proof from unseen first, excluding input network; no learning cost amortization.
cost_definition.native: one Z3 or Eldarica solver invocation on each raw original, same GitHub Ubuntu runner class and per engine wall ms excluding setup/network
cost_definition.ratio: only comparable if same correctness and rights; for native timeout, only report lower bound on restricted per-instance wall ratio, NOT whole-system 10x due uncaptured researcher/time/build cost
